symbol_counts.calculation: count each symbol after ASCII-only uppercase

unambiguous_nucleotide_count.calculation: sum A,C,G,T for dna; sum A,C,G,U for rna; otherwise null

ambiguous_symbol_count.calculation: sum R,Y,S,W,K,M,B,D,H,V,N for dna/rna; sum B,X,Z,J for protein; unspecified null

gc_count.calculation: C + G for declared dna/rna; otherwise null

gc_fraction.calculation: gc_count / gc_denominator; ambiguous and invalid symbols excluded

quality_observation_count.calculation: sum counts only for supported declared encoding and valid quality of matching length

expected_error_count.calculation: sum(count * error_probability); additive expectation does not assume independence

quality_thresholds.calculation: count_at_or_above=sum(count where unrounded phred >= threshold); fraction=count/denominator

definitions.missing: Unavailable measurements and zero-denominator fractions are null. A valid empty quality population has count and expected error sum zero.
definitions.measurement_kind: Counts are extracted from supplied symbols. Fractions and quality summaries are derived; errors are encoding-implied expectations, not observed errors.
definitions.uncertainty_meaning: No uncertainty intervals or quality calibration metadata were supplied.
